A kubectl-style registry for the git repositories on your machine.

 A project is a registered git repository: its path, an optional description
 and labels. Projects live in groups the way pods live in namespaces; the group
 is "default" unless -n is given, and -A lists every group.

 Resource types: projects (project, proj) and groups (group). Type words are case-insensitive.

Basic Commands:
  get             Display one or many resources
  describe        Show details of one or many resources
  create          Create a resource by name
  apply           Apply a configuration to a resource by file name or stdin
  delete          Delete resources by type and name
  edit            Edit a resource from the default editor
  label           Update the labels on a resource

Repository Commands:
  fetch           Fetch from the remote of each project

Settings Commands:
  config          Inspect the configuration in effect
  completion      Output shell completion code for the specified shell (bash, zsh, fish)
  man             Show the manual page of a command

Other Commands:
  help            Help about any command
  version         Print the version of slipway

Options:
      --color[=WHEN]   When to use color in the output; a bare --color means always. One of: auto, always, never.
  -n, --group NAME     The group scope for this request.
      --config PATH    Path to the configuration file.
  -h, --help           Print help and exit.
  -V, --version        Print the version and exit.

Usage:
  slipway [flags] COMMAND [ARGS...]

Use "slipway <command> --help" for more information about a given command.
